about: My practice brings together interaction design, systems thinking, and a deep interest in how people and technology work together.

contact.now: Every product exists within a larger human story. The professional building relationships, the patient navigating uncertainty, the athlete striving to improve, the teams keeping essential services running
contact.past: I'm interested in the systems that shape these experiences, and how software can help people do meaningful things with greater confidence, clarity, and agency
contact.bio2: Shaping products through UX Stories. Tinkerer for 6+ yrs. HCI is about to change. Design Systems & Cyberpunk music are my jam.
contact.wip: WIP: FUI concepts on Communication, Health, Identity. Aim to be a design engineer.
contact.quote: Sophistication is complexity made to simply work.
